fs.write:
version = 1
active = 1

[[tabs]]
kind = "path"
value = "$fixture"

[[tabs]]
kind = "path"
value = "$fixture/pictures"

quality.note: Real plain launch restores tab order and active tab; folder-argument launches skip and never overwrite tabs.toml; sole launch-routing guard

message: the launch on the fixture folder to show it
a launch with a folder argument to restore no saved tab
a launch with a folder argument to leave the saved session alone
a plain launch to restore the saved tabs with 'pictures' active
the restored active tab to show 'pictures'
the saved tabs to come back in their saved order
Ctrl+Shift+1 to select the first restored tab
a new third tab to open 'documents'
the plain-launch window to save its three tabs with 'documents' active
the relaunch on the fixture folder to show it
a relaunch with a folder argument to skip the saved session
a new tab in the folder-argument window to open 'archive'
a window opened for a folder argument to leave the saved session alone
the next plain launch to restore the earlier session with 'documents' active
the restored active tab to show 'documents'
the three saved tabs to come back in order, with no 'archive' tab from the folder-argument window
